checks.evidence: All quantitative claims in report.md have [EV:key] markers; each cited key appears in the supplied evidence_index.
Spot-checked reported values against facts.json, model.json, and valuation.json; cited figures and percentages agree within rounding.
Cited factual data keys resolve to AMD 10-Q or 10-K artifacts whose document IDs are listed in input_manifest; valuation keys resolve to the supplied valuation artifact.
The note identifies the absence of supplied risk disclosure text and does not fill that gap with a specific filing disclosure.

In the Outlook section, the note says the accepted proposal assumes restrained Client and Gaming growth and modest Embedded growth. Those proposal assumptions are not shown in the supplied facts.json, model.json, or valuation.json; the cited segment keys support historical results, not those forecast assumptions.

findings.summary: The note states segment-specific accepted forecast assumptions that are absent from the supplied artifacts.
findings.evidence: report.md, Outlook: “It assumes more restrained growth for Client and Gaming” and “modest growth for Embedded”; cited keys segments.client_and_gaming.operating_income and segments.embedded.revenue show historical series, not proposal assumptions. valuation.json does not provide segment-specific forecast growth paths.
findings.required_evidence: Provide the segment-specific forecast assumptions in a supplied artifact and cite the corresponding evidence keys, or remove the unsupported statements.
